payload.title: AI Builders Daily · 2026-08-24
payload.summary:
**Apple-native AI gets a new stack**: Claude plugs into Apple’s Foundation Models via Swift, blending on-device speed with heavier reasoning and web/code tools; **evals are the real moat**: builders keep hammering on stage-by-stage measurement, not vanity end scores; infra talk is shifting fast: cheaper inference, routing layers, and reliability are being treated like core utilities.
**苹果端侧 AI 又往前拱了一步**：Claude 接进 Foundation Models，Swift 这条线更顺了，本地模型和重推理开始像一套东西；**这波更硬的焦点其实是 eval**：别只盯最终答案，先把证据提取、分析、推荐这些环节拆开测；行业情绪也很直白：价格战还在压推理成本，网关和路由升温，老系统不变成 AI 的操作台，就可能被代理直接绕过去。

sections.headline: Top-down vs bottom-up AI evals · AI 评测的自上而下与自下而上
sections.body:
There are two types of AI evals - tops down and bottoms up.

From @sh_reya:

“Think of top-down as: If you’re in a vacuum, just given the task description, what would you come up with? **Claude** does a very good job of helping you with these top-down evals.

Bottom-up evals are the other half. When you look at lots and lots of sample outputs, what is your gut feedback that you want externalized into evals? “**Claude** is very, very bad at coming up with bottom-up evals. That’s all you.”

📌 Watch the full episode here: https://t.co/BuTklgfbr4

AI 评测有两种：自上而下和自下而上。

来自 @sh_reya：

“可以把自上而下理解为：如果你处在真空环境里，只拿到任务描述，你会设计出什么？**Claude** 在帮助你做这类自上而下的评测时，表现非常好。

自下而上评测是另一半。当你看了大量样本输出后，你直觉里的那些反馈，哪些值得被明确提炼成评测标准？而 **Claude** 非常、非常不擅长提出这类自下而上的评测。这部分得靠你自己。”

📌 完整节目在这里观看：https://t.co/BuTklgfbr4

sections.headline: How to build great evals: The Goldilocks principle for eval construction.｜如何构建优秀评测：评测设计的金发姑娘原则
sections.body:
How to build great evals - part 7.

The Goldilocks principle for eval construction.

Your evals should measure at the level of the various jobs to be done, not just the final answer.

E.g. consider a financial analysis agent. It's ultimate output is a stock recommendation. The most common mistake I see is teams create a golden set of right answers and check if the agent recommended the "right” stock.

The problem here is that there are probably a bunch of meaningful jobs that happened before this recommendation. E.g.

1/ Understanding the client: their portfolio, risk tolerance, investment horizon, goals, constraints

2/ Gather evidence: latest data points on the different stock stocks, the sectors, macro environment, **Fed** policy, recent and upcoming news events

3/ Analyze the data: revenue growth, valuation guidance, growth projections and produce a narrower number of candidate stocks

4/ Make a recommendation: stock ticker name, bid/sell price, timeframe

Each of these is a stage and produces an intermittent output. Each of them can (and maybe should have) their own eval so you can diagnose issues.

If the final recommendation is wrong, a well designed eval set would tell you:
Client understanding : 92%,
Evidence extraction : 92%,
Data analysis: 70%
Recommendation: 75%

Now you know where to go dig. And you might go, man the data analysis step is too complex and I need to break it down into a set of jobs to be done, and construct eval sets for them.

Not too granular. Not too coarse. Just right.
Make your eval set as granular as you need to diagnose and act.

Drop your eval questions in the comments and I will answer in future posts.

Share this with your teammates!

See you tomorrow.

如何构建优秀评测 - 第 7 部分。

评测设计里的金发姑娘原则。

你的评测应该衡量各个具体任务的完成情况，而不只是盯着最后答案。

比如，一个金融分析智能体，最终产出是股票推荐。我最常见到的错误，是团队先做一套“标准答案”，然后只看智能体有没有推荐“正确”的那只股票。

问题在于，这个推荐之前其实经历了很多有意义的环节。比如：

1/ 理解客户：他们的投资组合、风险承受能力、投资期限、目标、约束条件

2/ 收集证据：不同股票的最新数据点、所属板块、宏观环境、**Fed** 政策、近期和接下来的新闻事件

3/ 分析数据：营收增长、估值指引、增长预期，并把候选股票范围收窄

4/ 给出推荐：股票代码、买入/卖出价格、时间周期

这些都是独立阶段，而且每个阶段都会产出中间结果。每一步都可以，甚至应该有自己的评测，这样你才能定位问题。

如果最终推荐错了，一个设计合理的评测集应该能告诉你：
客户理解：92%
证据提取：92%
数据分析：70%
推荐生成：75%

这样你就知道该往哪里深挖了。你可能会发现，数据分析这一步太复杂了，需要继续拆成更细的一组任务，再分别给它们设计评测集。

别太细。也别太粗。要刚刚好。
你的评测集，颗粒度只需要细到足以诊断问题、支持行动。

把你的评测问题发到评论区，我会在之后的帖子里回答。

转给你的队友吧！

明天见。

sections.headline: **fx** extension philosophy: open protocols and **Unix** / **fx** 的扩展哲学：开放协议与 **Unix**
sections.body:
Our philosophy on extending **fx**: open protocols.
∙ **MCP** (modelcontextprotocol.io)
∙ **Skills** (agentskills.io)
∙ **Plugins** (agent-plugins.org)

And the best one, **Unix**:

① Small programs that do one thing well and compose by calling other programs.

② **libfx** that enables embeddability into more complex programs. You should be able to build your own CLI, background agent, software factory. Local or cloud.

我们对扩展 **fx** 的理念是：开放协议。
∙ **MCP** (modelcontextprotocol.io)
∙ **Skills** (agentskills.io)
∙ **Plugins** (agent-plugins.org)

还有最重要的那个，**Unix**：

① 程序要小，只把一件事做好，再通过调用其他程序把能力拼起来。

② **libfx** 让它可以嵌入更复杂的程序里。你应该能基于它搭出自己的 CLI、后台代理、软件工厂。既可以本地运行，也可以放到云上。

sections.headline: Leaving into the Unknown 走向未知的离开
sections.body:
leaving

leaving is the process from fullness into emptiness

from the familiar circle of life
the routines undone
the streets i knew by heart
the people i kept meeting
the names and labels that had gathered on my skin

toward a place entirely unknown
where a new life waits to be written

before i go
i take out everything i had hidden in my heart
and say goodbye to it
piece by piece

memory rises
and feeling rises with it

one by one
i empty the rooms within me
until i am almost as i was when i first arrived
unfurnished
unclaimed
open

what remains is a blankness
echoing with my fear of loneliness
my longing for freedom
and the questions i still cannot answer

what is freedom
what is happiness

when i first came here
i was drifting in a river
carried by the current
thinking only of making things

now i have to place my own hands on the helm

no longer mistaking the waves for fate
or the shore for salvation

i will miss the days i lived here

but i must learn again
how to sleep inside loneliness
how to eat inside uncertainty
how to recognize desire in the blank

and through the act of leaving
turn freedom from an idea
into a life i practice every day

离开

离开，就是从充盈走向空无的过程。

离开熟悉的生活圈，
那些被打乱的日常，
那些我早已烂熟于心的街道，
那些反复相遇的人，
那些一点点贴在我身上的名字与标签。

走向一个彻底陌生的地方，
在那里，一种新生活正等着被写下。

在我离开之前，
我把藏在心里的东西一件件取出来，
跟它们告别，
一点一点地。

记忆浮上来，
情绪也跟着浮上来。

我一间一间清空身体里的房间，
直到自己几乎回到初来时的样子：
没有陈设，
不属于谁，
敞开着。

最后剩下的是一片空白，
里面回荡着我对孤独的恐惧，
对自由的渴望，
还有那些至今仍答不出的问句。

什么是自由？
什么是幸福？

刚来这里的时候，
我像漂在一条河里，
顺着水流往前，
脑子里只想着去创造、去做东西。

而现在，
我得亲手握住船舵。

不再把浪当作命运，
也不再把岸当作救赎。

我会想念住在这里的那些日子。

但我必须重新学会，
怎样在孤独里入睡，
怎样在不确定里吃饭生活，
怎样在空白中认出自己的欲望。

并且借由离开这件事，
把自由从一个想法，
活成一种我每天都在练习的生活。

sections.headline: Claude joins Apple’s Foundation Models framework for smarter app workflows / **Claude** 接入 **Apple Foundation Models**，让应用工作流更聪明
sections.body:
**Anthropic** released a new **Swift** package that lets developers call **Claude** through **Apple’s Foundation Models framework**. The setup is intentionally simple: developers can start from typed **Swift** values produced by Apple’s native framework, use on-device models for quick local tasks, and then hand off to **Claude** when a request needs deeper reasoning, code generation, web search, or code execution.

这次 **Anthropic** 放出的，是一个新的 **Swift** 包。开发者可以直接在 **Apple Foundation Models** 这套框架里接入 **Claude**：简单的本地任务先交给设备端模型，碰到多步推理、代码生成、联网检索或数据分析，再无缝切到 **Claude**。整个链路都在 **Swift** 里完成，输入也更干净，不用直接拿原始用户文本硬喂模型。

sections.headline: Typed inputs, one user experience, better model routing / 类型化输入加统一体验，把模型分工这件事做好
sections.body:
A key point in the post is that **Apple’s Foundation Models framework** can return typed **Swift** values via `@Generable`, which means **Claude** receives structured inputs instead of noisy free-form text. That improves the handoff between local and remote models, while keeping streaming responses, tool calls, and structured outputs inside the same **SwiftUI** view.

文中一个很实用的点是：**Apple** 这套框架能通过 `@Generable` 直接产出类型化的 **Swift** 值。这样一来，传给 **Claude** 的不是杂乱的自然语言，而是整理过的结构化输入。好处很直接：本地模型和云端模型之间切换更稳，响应流、工具调用、结构化结果也都还能留在同一个 **SwiftUI** 视图里。

sections.headline: Use cases and platform rollout / 适用场景与平台发布时间
sections.body:
**Anthropic** highlights hybrid app patterns such as journaling, document, and study apps. For example, a journaling app might generate prompts on-device and then ask **Claude** to identify themes across months of entries; a study app might explain a term locally and escalate to **Claude** for broader conceptual reasoning. The package was announced on **June 8, 2026**, with availability stated for the next day across **iOS 27**, **iPadOS 27**, **macOS 27**, **visionOS 27**, and **watchOS 27** through **Apple’s Foundation Models framework**.

**Anthropic** 给的例子也比较明确：日记应用、文档应用、学习应用都适合这种双模型路线。比如日记应用可以先在本地生成提示，再让 **Claude** 去归纳几个月记录里的长期线索；学习应用可以先本地解释术语，等用户继续追问，再把更复杂的知识串联交给 **Claude**。

发布时间是 **2026 年 6 月 8 日**，文中说该支持会在次日开放，覆盖 **iOS 27**、**iPadOS 27**、**macOS 27**、**visionOS 27** 和 **watchOS 27**。
